entry.description: The accounts of your verified domains found in data breaches, one log per account and breach with the breach's details, and the most recently added breach, read from Have I Been Pwned's API.
entry.name: Have I Been Pwned
entry.setup:
1. Domain search needs a [paid subscription](https://haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key) and your domains verified in the
   [domain search dashboard](https://haveibeenpwned.com/DomainSearch).
2. Copy the API key from [your dashboard](https://haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key).

streams.description: One log per account of a verified domain and breach it was found in (service:breach), with the breach's details (Title, BreachDate, DataClasses, IsVerified, IsSensitive, …) and user_details.user_name / email_domain; sent once, when Have I Been Pwned first lists the account in the breach.
streams.name: Breached accounts

streams.description: The breach most recently added to Have I Been Pwned (service:latest-breach), once per breach.
streams.name: Latest breach

config.help: https://api.netbird.io for NetBird Cloud; your management server's URL when self-hosted (the one its dashboard calls).
config.label: Management URL

config.help: A service user's token with the Auditor or Admin role.
config.label: Personal access token

entry.description: The audit log of a NetBird account (peers added and removed, policies, routes, networks, DNS, setup keys, users and logins) as logs, and every peer's state (connected, last seen, login expired, OS and client version) as metrics, read every minute from NetBird Cloud or a self-hosted management server.
entry.name: NetBird
entry.setup:
1. In the NetBird dashboard, open **Team → Service Users** and create one, e.g. `observecraft-reader`, with the
   **Auditor** role (read-only; **Admin** works too). A regular user can't read the audit log.
2. Open the service user and **Create Token** (an expiration of up to a year); copy it, NetBird shows it once.

streams.description: Every audit event as a log (source:netbird): evt.name is NetBird's activity code, usr.* the initiator, netbird.category the code's first segment. Overused setup keys are errors; blocked users, expired logins and revoked keys warnings.
streams.name: Audit events

streams.description: Every peer's state as gauges, one series per peer (tags netbird_instance, peer, peer_id, os, netbird_version, country_code, city). Peers aren't hosts: a laptop joining the network is not infrastructure.

metrics.description: 1 per peer; summed, the peers (by os, netbird_version, country_code).
metrics.name: netbird.peer.count

metrics.description: 1 while the peer is connected to the management server, else 0.
metrics.name: netbird.peer.connected

metrics.description: Seconds since the peer was last seen (0 while connected).
metrics.name: netbird.peer.last_seen_age

metrics.description: 1 while the peer waits for an admin's approval.
metrics.name: netbird.peer.approval_required

metrics.description: 1 when the peer runs NetBird's SSH server.
metrics.name: netbird.peer.ssh_enabled

metrics.description: The peers its policies let it reach.
metrics.name: netbird.peer.accessible_peers

streams.name: Peers

dashboards.title: NetBird Overview
dashboards.description: Peers of a NetBird account (connected, last seen, expired logins, OS, client versions) and its audit log.

definition.content:
**NetBird** connects devices, servers and cloud resources over a WireGuard® overlay network. This dashboard shows the peers of the connected NetBird account (connected or not, last seen, expired logins, client versions) and its audit log: who added or removed peers, changed policies, routes, DNS and networks, created setup keys or invited users.

Connect an account in [Integrations → NetBird](/integrations/netbird): ObserveCraft reads its management API every minute, for NetBird Cloud and self-hosted NetBird alike.

definition.title: Peers added, removed and expired
definition.query: source:netbird @evt.name:(peer.user.add OR peer.setupkey.add OR user.peer.delete OR peer.login.expire OR peer.approve OR peer.approval.revoke)

definition.title: Access changes: policies, routes, networks, DNS
definition.query: source:netbird @netbird.category:(policy OR rule OR route OR network OR nameserver OR dns OR posture)

definition.title: Users, setup keys and tokens
definition.query: source:netbird @netbird.category:(user OR setupkey OR personal OR service OR account)
